mockup_note: 04-preview/mockups/sign-screen.html marks the three new blocks. The screen already existed; this adds to it rather than replacing it.
notes: Briefing a creator on a clean agreement creates her contract ready to sign, and the sign screen finally shows what she can sell, what her shoppers get and what happens to her content.
the_bug: She was briefed, landed in Invitations instead of To sign, and the detail screen rendered a BLANK PAGE. heroFor and sectionsFor matched the stage names used before Stage 1 renamed them — the two lists overlapped in exactly ONE value and everything else fell to a default reading 'This collab is closed'. The test file passed because every case fed it the OLD names, and its own closing comment already described this fault about a neighbouring function deleted in Stage 3 for exactly it.
the_gate: Only a CLEAN agreement goes straight to signing. agreement_warnings already said 'they will have to agree again' and nothing had ever acted on it. A drifted agreement still takes the old accept-first path, because a contract built on terms she never saw is not something she should be asked to sign.
three_things_she_was_signing_blind: What she can sell (decides her entire commission, never shown on any creator screen), the shopper offer and its valid window (Batch B gave every creator her own; she could see neither), and what happens to her content afterwards. All described on the SERVER via describeAllocation and describeUsage so no two surfaces can disagree.
one_sheet_not_two: DeclineSheet is shared by the contract screen and the collab screen. Copying it would have been a fourth duplicated vocabulary in a repo that has already deleted three.
live_bugs_fixed_on_the_way: 'not_a_fit' was sent as a decline reason and the server has NEVER accepted it — the collab screen's 'Not a fit' button returned 422 every single time anyone tapped it. The five valid keys now live in one exported list.
An invalid enum write was nearly shipped: UPDATE contracts SET status = 'cancelled' — contract_status has no such value. Replaced with a guarded DELETE of the unsigned contract.

verification.suite: Mobile 45 suites / 520 tests. usage-term 20/20, stage4-parcel 25/25, offers-parity 12/12, coupon 11/11.
verification.two_checks_passed_while_testing_nothing: toContain('askDeclineReason') was satisfied by the IMPORT line, so renaming the call site stayed green. toContain('ci.alloc_category') was satisfied by the longer ci.alloc_category_node_id, so deleting the category column stayed green. Both found by mutation, not by reading — the third and fourth time this session a check has passed by matching something other than what it meant to. Both tightened and re-mutated.

carried_not_fixed: cancelInfluencer still writes status = 'cancelled' to contract_status, which has no such value. Confirmed live, out of scope here.
scope_excluded: The screens that let a brand ASK FOR commercial usage — the term exists, no surface offers it

release.deploy_class: production-impacting (backend/src + influencer OTA). Migration 163 already applied to production.
release.outward_facing: Every creator briefed from now on takes the new route. Rows already at 'invited' are untouched.
release.device_walk_required: YES — brief a creator on a clean agreement from the founder's phone and walk To sign -> read -> sign, then a second creator -> decline with a note.
